label: msg_field_trade_system_01
text: That Pokémon doesn’t meet the conditions of\nthe trade!

label: msg_field_trade_a_01
text:
Do you have the Pokémon Flabébé? They can
carry different-colored flowers, right?\c
Could you trade me a Flabébé for my Snom?
Any color of flower is fine by me!

label: msg_field_trade_a_02
text: You’re going to trade me that Flabébé?

label: msg_field_trade_a_03
text: Agh, too bad! Well, let me know if you change\nyour mind!

label: msg_field_trade_a_04
text:
Wow, it’s so small... So cute... The way it rides on
that flower is just... Mmm!\c
...Whew. Snom’s really adorable too, so take
good care of it, OK?

label: msg_field_trade_a_05
text: Flabébé is just so cute! Maybe I’ll catch all the\ndifferent-colored Flabébé!

label: msg_field_trade_a_06
text: You can’t trade if you only have one Pokémon!\c\nCome back when you have at least two Pokémon\non your team!

label: msg_field_trade_b_01
text: Is it true that Wooper in Paldea are venomous?\c\nI have a blue Wooper I caught in another region.\nWanna trade a Paldean Wooper to get it?

label: msg_field_trade_b_02
text: Wow, that Wooper’s got a dark color...\nYou sure you’re OK to trade?

label: msg_field_trade_b_03
text: Let me know if you change your mind and want\nto have a Wooper trade-off!

label: msg_field_trade_b_04
text:
Wow, it really does have the Poison type!
That’s so cool!\c
The blue Wooper’s neat too, so make sure you
give it lots of attention, OK?

label: msg_field_trade_b_05
text:
Oooh, its eyes get droopy when they’re closed!
Paldean Wooper is SO cute!\c
It’s neat that the same Pokémon, depending on
the region, can have different looks and types!

label: msg_field_trade_b_06
text: Oh, but you only have one Pokémon!\c\nYou need to have at least two Pokémon on your\nteam if you want to trade!

label: msg_field_trade_c_01
text:
I don’t have a Pokémon that I can ride on water,
but I want to meet some lovely sea Pokémon!\c
If you have a Pincurchin, would you be willing to
trade it for my Haunter?

label: msg_field_trade_c_02
text: You’re OK with trading that Pincurchin?

label: msg_field_trade_c_03
text: Aww, you don’t want to trade? Sometimes you\ngotta make bold decisions in life, you know?

label: msg_field_trade_c_04
text:
Oh my! My darling Hauntikins evolved into
Gengar?!\c
I’d heard rumors about Pokémon that evolve
when they’re traded!

label: msg_field_trade_c_05
text: How’s dear Hauntikins doing? The Pincurchin\nyou gave me is just electrifying!

label: msg_field_trade_c_06
text:
You can’t do a trade if you only have one
Pokémon on your team!\c
I think you should come back when you have
at least two!
